zh.title: 澳洲航空取消3條波音787國際航線
zh.summary: 澳洲航空調整長程機隊配置；取消3條波音787國際航線並移出雪梨服務
body: 澳洲航空（Qantas）宣佈調整旗下長程機隊配置，決定取消 3 條使用波音 787（Boeing 787）客機營運的國際航線。根據相關規劃，這項營運調整將直接改變該公司未來的整體運能與國際航線排程。
在此次長程機隊的重新調配過程中，澳洲航空將把 Dreamliner 客機移出布里斯本（Brisbane）與雪梨（Sydney）的相關航班服務。此舉將進一步調整相關航線的客運載運量與具體的飛行路線規劃。

en.title: Qantas Cancels 3 International Boeing 787 Routes
en.summary: Qantas reshuffles long-haul fleet; cancels three Boeing 787 routes and alters Brisbane and Sydney services.
body: Qantas is reshuffling its long-haul aircraft fleet, leading to the cancellation of three international routes operated by Boeing 787 Dreamliner aircraft. The operational adjustment is expected to alter the carrier's broader international routing plans and overall seat capacity distribution across its long-haul network.

As part of the fleet deployment changes, Qantas will remove Boeing 787 Dreamliners from services operating out of Brisbane and Sydney. The strategic relocation of these widebody aircraft directly impacts existing flight schedules and capacity routing plans for the affected international departures.

zh.title: 川普預期中國再購250架波音飛機 先前200架承諾狀態未公開釐清
zh.summary: 川普預期中國再購250架波音飛機，先前200架承諾狀態未公開釐清。
body: 美國總統川普表示，預期中國將再購買250架波音飛機。AeroTime報導，川普是在中國深圳與中國國家主席習近平會面數日後提出這項預測。
川普接受CNBC訪問時，未說明可能採購的機型、交付時程或涉及的航空公司。報導指出，至報導時中國尚未討論額外購買波音飛機的計畫。
此外，這項預測與2026年5月公佈的200架飛機承諾不同；該承諾目前的狀態尚未公開釐清。波音當時將這項承諾描述為初步承諾，而非最終訂單。

en.title: Trump expects China to buy 250 more Boeing aircraft as earlier pledge status remains unclear
en.summary: Trump expects China to buy 250 more Boeing aircraft; the status of an earlier 200-aircraft commitment remains unclear.
body: US President Donald Trump said he expects China to buy another 250 Boeing aircraft. AeroTime reported that he made the prediction days after meeting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China.

In an interview with CNBC, Trump did not identify the aircraft models, a delivery schedule or the airlines that could be involved. China has not discussed plans for additional Boeing jets, the report said.

The prediction is separate from a 200-aircraft commitment announced in May 2026, whose status has not been publicly clarified. Boeing described that commitment at the time as initial rather than a finalized order.

zh.title: 達美航空載重平衡系統故障，感恩節前逾千航班延誤
zh.summary: 達美航空 11 月 22 日一度改用人工計算起飛前的載重與平衡。美國聯邦航空總署短暫暫停部分飛往亞特蘭大的航班起飛；系統恢復後，航班仍有延誤。
body: 美國感恩節旅運高峰前，達美航空 11 月 22 日（週日）用於起飛前載重與平衡計算的自動化系統發生故障。達美表示，修復期間改以人工計算，讓航班能安全放行；當天稍晚自動計算功能恢復，但航班一時未能恢復正常。美聯社報導，達美當天有逾千班航班延誤。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）應達美要求，一度暫停部分飛往哈茲菲爾德－傑克遜亞特蘭大國際機場（ATL）的達美及其區域支線航班起飛，隨後改採地面延誤計畫。FAA 表示，這次延誤與其航管系統無關。
達美表示，將協助受影響旅客改訂航班，並在有需要時提供餐食及住宿。航班取消且選擇不旅行的旅客可獲退款。

en.title: Delta Air Lines weight-and-balance outage delays more than 1,000 flights before Thanksgiving
en.summary: Delta switched to manual pre-departure weight-and-balance calculations on November 22. The FAA briefly held some Atlanta-bound flights at their departure airports, and delays continued after the airline restored the system.
body: Delta Air Lines' automated system for calculating aircraft weight and balance before departure failed on Sunday, November 22, as Thanksgiving travel picked up in the United States. Delta said it switched to manual calculations to dispatch flights safely while it fixed the system. Automation returned later that day, but service did not immediately return to normal. The Associated Press reported that more than 1,000 Delta flights were delayed on Sunday.

At Delta's request, the Federal Aviation Administration briefly held some Delta and regional affiliate flights bound for Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) at their departure airports. The FAA then replaced the ground stop with a ground delay program. The agency said the delays were unrelated to its own air traffic systems.
Delta said it was rebooking affected travelers and providing meals and hotel rooms where needed. The airline said customers whose flights were canceled could get refunds if they chose not to travel.
